overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Serenity 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for spaces like basements or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and enhanced circulation. Constructed from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features 6 advanced heaters, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels, ensuring a safe and effective infrared experience. With its interior chromotherapy lighting and Bluetooth connectivity, the Serenity sauna transforms your space into a personalized spa environment.
